features.pageSubtitle: Discover the seven layers of protection that make PayShield the most secure payment platform

spiceLock.title: The Spice Lock - 3 Layer Protection
spiceLock.subtitle: Your password receives two secret ingredients before being stored, making it virtually impossible to crack.
spiceLock.saltTitle: 🧂 Salt: Random Spice Unique to You
spiceLock.saltDesc: Every user gets a unique 16-digit random number generated when creating their account. This salt is mixed with your password before encryption, ensuring that even if two users have the same password, their encrypted versions are completely different.
spiceLock.pepperTitle: 🌶️ Pepper: Master Spice Only Server Knows
spiceLock.pepperDesc: The server adds its own secret ingredient that exists only on our secure servers. This master pepper is never transmitted to your browser, adding an extra layer of protection against client-side attacks.
spiceLock.registration: Registration: System generates random 16-digit salt → Mixes with your password → Browser generates pepper code → Combined for encryption
spiceLock.login: Login: You enter your password → System sprinkles salt → Browser sprinkles pepper → Verification complete

mirrorMaze.title: The Mirror Maze - 3 Fake Reflections
mirrorMaze.subtitle: Instead of one account, we create four identical rooms. Hackers always enter the fake ones!
mirrorMaze.realSubtext: Hidden and protected - only accessible with proper authentication
mirrorMaze.decoy1Desc: Realistic fake account to mislead intruders
mirrorMaze.decoy2Desc: Another convincing decoy with transaction history
mirrorMaze.decoy3Desc: Lower balance decoy to appear authentic
mirrorMaze.whyDesc: Hackers believe they've succeeded when they access a decoy account. They see realistic balances and transaction histories, so they stop trying to break in further. Meanwhile, our system has already detected the intrusion and alerted you.

digitalPassport.title: The Digital Passport
digitalPassport.subtitle: Every login checks your travel documents - location, device, and timing.
digitalPassport.geoDesc: Since UPI transactions only work in India, Nepal, Bhutan, and France, the system automatically flags any payment attempt from other countries. If your last transaction was in India and suddenly there's an attempt from China, the account is immediately frozen.

childhoodWhisper.title: The Childhood Whisper
childhoodWhisper.subtitle: Only you know these secrets from your past - cryptographically encrypted on blockchain.
childhoodWhisper.step1Desc: During registration, you provide two secret answers:
childhoodWhisper.step1Question1: What did your mother call you?
childhoodWhisper.step1Question2: What was your first pet's name?
childhoodWhisper.step2Desc: Answers are cryptographically encrypted and stored on blockchain
childhoodWhisper.step3Question: System asks: "What was mom's name for you + first pet?"
childhoodWhisper.step3Real: Real user: "ChintuTommy" → Access to real account
childhoodWhisper.step3Hacker: Hacker: Wrong answer → Stuck in fake account

slowMotionTrap.title: The Slow Motion Trap
slowMotionTrap.subtitle: When unusual activity is detected, time slows down while we protect you.
slowMotionTrap.t1Desc: Anomaly detected - activating slow motion protocol
slowMotionTrap.t2Desc: GSM call triggered to your registered mobile
slowMotionTrap.t5Desc: IP address, browser fingerprint, behavior patterns logged
slowMotionTrap.t30Desc: Hacker sees: "Transaction Successful" (but it never happened)

deviceDNA.title: The Device DNA
deviceDNA.subtitle: Your device has unique DNA - 20+ identifiers that can't be faked.
deviceDNA.mlDesc: Our AI model learns your device's unique signature. If someone tries to login from a device with different DNA - even if they have your password - the security questions are triggered to verify your identity.

behaviorCamera.title: The Behavior Camera
behaviorCamera.subtitle: AI watches how you interact - everyone has unique digital behavior patterns.
behaviorCamera.normalPattern: Transaction Pattern: Checks balance → Reviews history → Initiates transfer
behaviorCamera.normalTiming: Timing: Usually logs in at 10 AM, 2 PM, 8 PM
behaviorCamera.hackerPattern: Transaction Pattern: Immediately clicks "Transfer all money"
behaviorCamera.hackerAmount: Amount Pattern: Tries to transfer entire balance at once
behaviorCamera.aiDesc: Our machine learning model tracks each user's unique patterns:
behaviorCamera.aiTime: Payment Time: When you typically make transactions
behaviorCamera.aiAmount: Payment Amount: Your usual transaction ranges
behaviorCamera.aiFrequency: Payment Frequency: How often you transfer money
behaviorCamera.aiMouse: Mouse Scrolling: Your unique way of navigating
behaviorCamera.aiClick: Click Patterns: Speed and sequence of actions
behaviorCamera.aiConclusion: Any deviation triggers additional verification to ensure it's really you.

alertSystem.subtitle: Instant multi-channel notifications the moment suspicious activity is confirmed.
alertSystem.gsmDesc: Automated call to your registered mobile using GSM IoT module

alertSystem.emailDesc: Detailed security report sent to your email
alertSystem.freezeDesc: Payment interface immediately locked until further notice

about.pageSubtitle: Revolutionizing payment security with military-grade protection
about.missionText: At PayShield, we believe that financial security should be unbreakable. In an era where cyber threats are becoming increasingly sophisticated, traditional security measures are no longer enough. That's why we've developed a revolutionary 7-layer security system that combines advanced cryptography, artificial intelligence, and behavioral analytics to protect your financial transactions.
about.missionContinued: Our mission is to make world-class security accessible to everyone, ensuring that your hard-earned money remains safe from even the most advanced cyber attacks.
about.multiLayerDesc: Unlike single-point security systems, we deploy seven independent layers of protection. Even if hackers breach one layer, six others stand in their way.
about.aiPoweredDesc: Our machine learning algorithms learn your unique behavior patterns and can detect anomalies that traditional rule-based systems would miss.
about.deceptionDesc: We don't just block attackers - we deceive them with fake accounts and slow motion traps, buying time to protect you and gather evidence.
about.blockchainDesc: Critical security data is encrypted and stored on blockchain, making it virtually impossible for hackers to access or tamper with.
about.cryptographyDesc: We use military-grade encryption with unique salt and pepper techniques, ensuring your credentials are protected even if databases are compromised.
about.realtimeDesc: Our system doesn't just detect threats - it responds instantly with account freezes, user alerts, and evidence collection.
about.securityList: AES-256 Encryption / RSA Cryptography / Blockchain / Salt & Pepper Hashing / bcrypt
about.aiList: Machine Learning / Behavioral Analytics / Anomaly Detection / Pattern Recognition / Neural Networks
about.realtimeSystemsList: GSM IoT Integration / WebSocket / Event-Driven Architecture / Real-Time Monitoring
about.fingerprintingList: Canvas Fingerprinting / WebGL Signatures / Browser DNA / Hardware Profiling
about.teamIntro: PayShield is built by a team of cybersecurity experts, cryptographers, and AI researchers with decades of combined experience in financial security.
about.securityExpertsDesc: Former cybersecurity analysts from leading financial institutions
about.cryptographersDesc: PhD researchers specializing in advanced encryption techniques
about.aiEngineersDesc: Machine learning specialists from top tech companies
about.securityFirstDesc: We never compromise on security. Every feature, every line of code is designed with security as the top priority.
about.transparencyDesc: We believe users have the right to understand how their security works. That's why we openly explain our protection mechanisms.
about.innovationDesc: Cyber threats evolve constantly, and so do we. We continuously research and implement cutting-edge security technologies.
about.userCentricDesc: Advanced security shouldn't be complicated. We make enterprise-grade protection accessible and easy to use for everyone.
about.ctaSubtitle: Join thousands of users who trust PayShield with their financial safety

contact.pageSubtitle: Have questions? We're here to help. Reach out to our team anytime.
contact.messagePlaceholder: Tell us how we can help you...
contact.faq1A: PayShield employs 7 layers of advanced security including military-grade encryption, AI-powered behavioral analytics, blockchain storage, and real-time threat detection. We maintain a 99.9% threat detection rate.
contact.faq2Q: What happens if my account is compromised?
contact.faq2A: Our system immediately detects suspicious activity and activates multiple protection mechanisms: redirecting attackers to decoy accounts, freezing your real account, sending you instant alerts via GSM/SMS, and collecting evidence for law enforcement.
contact.faq3Q: How does the Mirror Maze work?
contact.faq3A: We create 3 fake accounts with realistic balances alongside your real account. Unauthorized access attempts are automatically redirected to these decoy accounts, making attackers believe they've succeeded while your actual funds remain protected.
contact.faq4A: PayShield is optimized for UPI transactions, which work in India, Nepal, Bhutan, and France. Our Digital Passport feature automatically blocks suspicious transactions from other countries to protect your account.
contact.faq5A: Device DNA is our unique fingerprinting technology that identifies your device using 20+ characteristics like screen resolution, browser signature, timezone, hardware markers, and more. This ensures only your trusted devices can access your account.
contact.faq6Q: How do I add a new trusted device?
contact.faq6A: When you login from a new device, our system will ask you to answer your security questions (The Childhood Whisper) to verify your identity. Once verified, the device is automatically added to your trusted devices list.
contact.faq7Q: What is the Slow Motion Trap?
contact.faq7A: When suspicious activity is detected, we deliberately slow down the transaction by 30 seconds. During this time, we alert you, collect evidence, notify authorities, and show the attacker a fake success message - all while preventing any actual transfer of funds.
contact.faq8A: Absolutely. Your security questions are encrypted and stored on blockchain, never on your device or browser. Your passwords go through salt & pepper encryption. We use AES-256 encryption for all sensitive data and comply with international data protection regulations.
